title: Do Factuality Methods Make LLMs More Factual? Reproducibility and Fair Comparison
abstract: arXiv:2610.18415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. translated_title: 事实性方法能让大语言模型更符合事实吗？可复现性与公平比较
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在经过预训练和监督微调步骤之后，会与人类偏好进行对齐。然而，诸如RLHF等标准的强化学习对齐步骤并不专注于大语言模型的事实性，因此它们可能生成不符合事实的信息，这可能导致意想不到的后果。为此，文献中提出了许多事实性对齐方法，声称可以在各自使用的基准上提升大语言模型的事实性。然而，这些方法尚未被独立复现，而且由于每个方法使用了不同的基础模型、训练数据、评估集、评判模型和评估指标，它们之间也无法进行公平比较。在本文中，我们首次对五种事实性对齐方法进行了独立复现，这些方法涵盖在线策略强化学习（PPO、GRPO和Dr. GRPO）以及离线偏好优化（DPO和KTO），并在统一基准上使用统一的评估指标对它们进行比较。我们发现这些方法均未能……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次独立复现并在统一基准上公平比较了五种事实性对齐方法（PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO、DPO和KTO），发现这些方法均无法可靠地提升大语言模型的事实性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first independent reproduction and fair comparison of five factuality alignment methods (PPO, GRPO, Dr. GRPO, DPO, and KTO) on a common benchmark, finding that none of these methods reliably make LLMs more factual.
